arabic text: Ro ke zainab nay kaha ay mere bhai Abbas\nAag zalim nay hay khemon main lagai Abbas
english translation text: Weeping, Zainab said: O my brother Abbas,\nthe oppressor has set the tents on fire, Abbas.

arabic text: Kaysay tujh ko main batawon wo ajab lamhay thay\nSath shabir kay tu tha nhi yun khemay main\nLaash Akber ki boht dair se aai Abbas
english translation text: How can I describe those strange moments to you?\nYou were not beside Shabbir when he was in the tents;\nAkbar's body returned only after a very long time, Abbas.

arabic text: Naam darbaar main zalim ne liya jub mera\nKhoon rotay howay sajjad yahi kehta tha\nHaye afosos ke kiu mout na naa aai Abbas
english translation text: When the oppressor called my name within the court,\nSajjad wept blood and said:\nalas, why did death not come to me, Abbas?

arabic text: Sath akber hain na qasim hain na asghar bhayya\nKoi yawar hai na sayaa koi sar par bhayya\nMujh ko acchi nhi lagti ye judai Abbas
english translation text: Neither Akbar, nor Qasim, nor Asghar remains, brother;\nthere is no helper and no shade above my head.\nThis separation does not feel bearable, Abbas.

arabic text: Dard ye sath Meray qabr talak jaaye ga\nHo gaye sham ke zindaan se sub log Riha\nBus sakina ne rehai nhi paai Abbas
english translation text: This pain will remain with me until the grave.\nEveryone was freed from the prison of Shaam,\nbut Sakina never received freedom, Abbas.

arabic text: Ho bhala Kaysay bayan lafzoon main halat meri\nSab musalmano ki basti thi jahan say guzre\nEk basti main bhi chadar nahi paai abbas.
english translation text: How can my condition be expressed in words?\nEvery place we passed was a settlement of Muslims,\nyet not in a single one did I find a chadar, Abbas.

arabic text: Choor Kar bhai youn Kaun bhala jaata hay\nLash e Shabbir pay ro ro kay khayal ata hay\nMain madinay se kafan kyon nahi laaye Abbas
english translation text: Who leaves his brother in such a state?\nWeeping over Shabbir's body, this thought came to me:\nwhy did I not bring a shroud from Madina, Abbas?

arabic text: Aik bhi waar na honay diya main nay tujh par Apne khotbon se jala deti thi\nzalim ka jigar\nMain ne ik pal na suni teri buraie Abbas
english translation text: I did not allow even one attack upon you;\nthrough my sermons I burned the tyrant's heart.\nNot for a single moment did I listen to anyone insult you, Abbas.

arabic text: Mujh ko pardais main tha Tera sahara bhayya Kis pay tum choor gaye apni\nbehan ko tanha\nMain nay har moor pay thi tum ko sada dee abbas
english translation text: You were my support in a foreign land, brother;\nwith whom did you leave your sister all alone?\nAt every turn, I called out to you, Abbas.

arabic text: Tazkira karta hay jab koi karimi ka kahin Aysa Lagta hay ye ashhar kay\nhain Abbas yahin Tujh pay naaza'n meray bhai hay khudaye, abbas
english translation text: Whenever anyone mentions your generosity, it feels, O poet, as though Abbas\nis present here. My brother, even God takes pride in you, Abbas.
